title: Sentinel-3 海陸環境觀測
summary: 以簡化雙通道模型估算海表溫度，追蹤大氣修正與共同校準偏差。
summaryEn: Estimate sea-surface temperature with a simplified two-channel model and track atmospheric correction and common calibration bias.
scope: 本課採用原創紙面、試算表或離線模型練習。案例來源用於查證背景；數值、擾動及驗收門檻是明示的教學假設，不是設備規格、製程配方、臨床操作或飛行程序。實作成果是可重算的分析紀錄。

steps.observation: 對照組與變更組的差異能追到明確輸入或量測機制。新 Ts=294 K，斜率為 2 K/單位係數。
steps.observationEn: Differences between control and changed runs trace to explicit inputs or measurement mechanisms. New Ts is 294 K and slope is 2 K per coefficient unit.
steps.failure: 同時變更多個輸入卻把結果歸因於單一因素。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple inputs and attributing the output difference to a single factor.
steps.check: 每一通道配對都有共同位置與時間容許差。
steps.checkEn: Every channel pair has explicit spatial and temporal tolerances.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: Sentinel-3 結合海陸顏色、溫度與測高儀器；SLSTR 採雙視角觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Sentinel-3 combines colour, temperature and altimetry instruments; SLSTR uses two viewing directions.

knowledge.text: 以簡化雙通道模型估算海表溫度，追蹤大氣修正與共同校準偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate sea-surface temperature with a simplified two-channel model and track atmospheric correction and common calibration bias.

knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學分裂窗模型 Ts=T1+a(T1−T2)；係數取決於校準情境，不能當作任務正式反演。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching split-window model Ts=T1+a(T1−T2); the coefficient is calibration-dependent and not the mission retrieval.

quiz.question: 「通道與視角對齊」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Align channels and views: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: 交付通道表、係數版本、雲遮罩及偏差試驗，不以精密度代替準確度。
兩通道同偏 +1 K 時差值不變但 Ts 偏 +1 K；差分不能去掉共同絕對校準偏差。
optionsEn: Ts=290+1.5×(290−288)=293 K. Subtract 273.15 when converting the final absolute temperature to Celsius;do not subtract it from a temperature difference.
Deliver channel data, coefficient revision, cloud mask and bias tests, distinguishing precision from accuracy.
A common +1 K bias leaves the channel difference unchanged but shifts Ts by +1 K; differencing does not remove absolute bias.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。兩通道同偏 +1 K 時差值不變但 Ts 偏 +1 K；差分不能去掉共同絕對校準偏差。 與本階段判準一起判讀：每一通道配對都有共同位置與時間容許差。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. A common +1 K bias leaves the channel difference unchanged but shifts Ts by +1 K; differencing does not remove absolute bias. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Every channel pair has explicit spatial and temporal tolerances.

steps.title: 通道與視角對齊 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Align channels and views · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「通道與視角對齊」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Align channels and views and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
兩通道同偏 +1 K 時差值不變但 Ts 偏 +1 K；差分不能去掉共同絕對校準偏差。
對照「通道與視角對齊」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。只有晴空、同地點同時間且係數適用時接受估值；雲污染先遮罩。
本階段必須重驗：每一通道配對都有共同位置與時間容許差。
steps.instructionEn:
A common +1 K bias leaves the channel difference unchanged but shifts Ts by +1 K; differencing does not remove absolute bias.
Against the nominal Align channels and views result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Accept estimates only for clear sky, common space/time sampling and valid coefficients; mask clouds first.
Reverify this criterion: Every channel pair has explicit spatial and temporal tolerances.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。兩通道同偏 +1 K 時差值不變但 Ts 偏 +1 K；差分不能去掉共同絕對校準偏差。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. A common +1 K bias leaves the channel difference unchanged but shifts Ts by +1 K; differencing does not remove absolute bias.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 每一通道配對都有共同位置與時間容許差。
steps.checkEn: Every channel pair has explicit spatial and temporal tolerances.

quiz.questionEn: Align channels and views: Which statement gives the evidence-based disposition or re-verification condition?
options: 教學分裂窗模型 Ts=T1+a(T1−T2)；係數取決於校準情境，不能當作任務正式反演。

Accept estimates only for clear sky, common space/time sampling and valid coefficients; mask clouds first.
Sentinel-3 combines colour, temperature and altimetry instruments; SLSTR uses two viewing directions.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「處置與重新驗證」。只有晴空、同地點同時間且係數適用時接受估值；雲污染先遮罩。 與本階段判準一起判讀：每一通道配對都有共同位置與時間容許差。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies disposition and re-verification. Accept estimates only for clear sky, common space/time sampling and valid coefficients; mask clouds first. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Every channel pair has explicit spatial and temporal tolerances.

steps.title: 通道與視角對齊 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Align channels and views · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「通道與視角對齊」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Align channels and views and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付通道表、係數版本、雲遮罩及偏差試驗，不以精密度代替準確度。
在交接件中加入「通道與視角對齊」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：每一通道配對都有共同位置與時間容許差。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：以簡化雙通道模型估算海表溫度，追蹤大氣修正與共同校準偏差。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver channel data, coefficient revision, cloud mask and bias tests, distinguishing precision from accuracy.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Align channels and views: Every channel pair has explicit spatial and temporal tolerances.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Estimate sea-surface temperature with a simplified two-channel model and track atmospheric correction and common calibration bias. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。每一通道配對都有共同位置與時間容許差。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Every channel pair has explicit spatial and temporal tolerances.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 每一通道配對都有共同位置與時間容許差。
steps.checkEn: Every channel pair has explicit spatial and temporal tolerances.
